item.title: Ten Frame Counting and Number Writing Practice for Ages 3 to 6 (Numbers 1 to 20)
item.description: Number practice pages for children ages 3 to 6. Each printable worksheet shows the number on a ten frame, gives pictures to count, then tracing and writing practice and a missing number line. Useful for homeschool preschool, morning work and maths centres.
